title: A Stretchable Nanowire UV-Vis-NIR Photodetector with High Performance

nodes.label: UV-to-NIR nanowire photodetectors reported so far combine low ON/OFF ratios with slow (>10 s) UV response

requires_unseen: Table 1 comparison with previous NWPDs (linked text)

nodes.label: PbS QDs blended into P3HT nanowires should sensitise the NIR and, via charge transfer, raise ON/OFF and speed

requires_unseen: QDs as NIR sensitizers and QD/P3HT charge transfer (linked text, refs 11, 12)

nodes.label: Add PbS quantum dots (4.4-9.1 nm) to a P3HT nanowire as NIR sensitizer and charge-transfer partner

requires_unseen: QD size range 4.4-9.1 nm and sensitizer role (linked text)

nodes.label: Freestanding single nanowire arches spanning Au and Al electrodes, the array embedded in PDMS for stretching

attrs.image_note: F1a scheme shows the arch from Au to Al on SiO2/Si; F4a shows 3x3 array of arches in PDMS pulled apart

nodes.label: PbS QDs synthesised by pyrolysis of organometallic precursors
Meniscus-guided direct writing pulls a blend-solution meniscus into a freestanding NW arch bonded between Au and Al
PbS QDs are dispersed uniformly through the single hybrid NW without large clusters

attrs.image_note: Dark few-nm dots spread along the ~270 nm wide NW; EDS inset labels Pb,S; dispersion at other loadings (Fig. S8) not in packet

nodes.label: Each hybrid NW forms a freestanding arch lifted off the substrate between its two contacts
Photoinduced charge transfer between PbS QDs and P3HT, dominated by hole transfer QD to P3HT, extracts photocarriers

requires_unseen: hole-transfer dominance argued from literature fluorescent fractions (linked text)

nodes.label: Hybrid NW photoresponse extends into the NIR (850-940 nm) because PbS QDs absorb there

attrs.image_note: 850/940 nm ON/OFF points exist only with QDs (F3a) and the ~1150 nm band only in QD films (F3c inset); NIR ON/OFF only ~2-15; 0 wt% (P3HT-only) device still shows ON/OFF ~3 at 740 nm (F3a), see audit o21, so 740 nm is not claimed

nodes.label: Single hybrid NW photodetector switches cleanly from 365 to 850 nm with ON/OFF up to ~600 and sub-second rise/fall

attrs.image_note: ON/OFF ~320 (365 nm), ~600 (625 nm), ~15 (850 nm); rise/fall annotated <=0.16 to ~0.58 s

nodes.label: The arch geometry takes up substrate stretching by straightening, relaxing strain in the NW

requires_unseen: authors' attribution of stability to strain relaxation by the arch (linked text)

nodes.label: Array photoresponse, ON/OFF and rise/fall times stay essentially unchanged up to 100% stretching and over 100 cycles
Direct-written PbS QD-P3HT NW arches give a broadband UV-vis-NIR photodetector that keeps its performance under 100% stretching
Vary QD loading 0-60 wt% (at 4.4 nm) and QD size 4.4-9.1 nm (at 60 wt%)

requires_unseen: fixed size 4.4 nm in loading series and fixed 60 wt% in size series (linked text)

nodes.label: ON/OFF ratio rises with QD loading at every wavelength from 365 to 940 nm
ON/OFF ratio rises as QD size decreases at every wavelength
ON/OFF two orders higher in UV-vis and response 0.11-0.58 s versus >10 s UV response of earlier UV-NIR NWPDs
Slight fall of ON/OFF over repeated switching, attributed to photobleaching
Fluorescent exciton fraction is ~20% in PbS QDs but ~1% in P3HT, so PL quenching mainly probes QD-side transfer
Approximate band alignment: HOMO offset for hole transfer QD to P3HT becomes unfavourable as QD size grows

requires_unseen: band alignment Fig. S10a (not in packet)

nodes.label: Arched or buckled interconnect architectures relax external strain in stretchable electronics
SEM inset: a single thin curved NW spans the electrode gap as an arc

attrs.image_note: inset at 10 um scale, top-down view: the arc is a uniform dark line whose height above the substrate cannot be read, and at this resolution it is hard to tell from a drawn guide; lift-off is shown by F4b side views. Label 'PbS QD-P3HT NW' is an annotation

nodes.label: TEM: few-nm dark dots spread evenly over the whole NW width and length, no clusters
EDS inset: peaks labelled Pb,S plus C and Cu

attrs.image_note: Cu and most C assigned to grid and carbon mesh in text

nodes.label: Cycled ON/OFF levels ~320 at 365 nm, ~600 at 625 nm, ~15 at 850 nm
625 nm ON/OFF peaks fall from ~620 to ~480 over six cycles; 365 nm from ~330 to ~300
ON/OFF rises ~5-20x from 0 to 60 wt% QD for all nine wavelengths; 625 nm highest
850 and 940 nm ON/OFF series start at 20 wt%; no points at 0 wt% QD

attrs.image_note: absence of markers may mean no response or not measured; P3HT-only UV-vis limit is from Fig. S4 (text)

nodes.label: ON/OFF falls from 4.4 to 9.1 nm QD size at all wavelengths (625 nm ~200 to ~30)
Visible absorbance rises with QD loading: band maximum ~1.6 (0 wt%) to ~3.5 (60 wt%)
Inset: ~1150 nm absorption band in 60 and 40 wt% films, faint at 20 wt%, absent at 0 wt%

attrs.image_note: text says all hybrid films show the band; at 20 wt% it is barely resolved

nodes.label: Blend PL lies below pristine QD PL at 4.4, 4.7 and 5.5 nm
Blend/QD PL peak ratio ~0.75 at 4.4 nm, ~0.77 at 4.7 nm, ~0.9 at 5.5 nm: quenching weakens with size

attrs.image_note: peak heights above baseline measured on the crop; the 4.4 to 4.7 nm step is small, most of the weakening is between 4.7 and 5.5 nm

nodes.label: Optical micrographs: arch height drops at 50% and the NW is nearly straight at 100% stretch, unbroken

attrs.image_note: strain labels 0/50/100% are OCR tokens, not listed annotations; photograph of flexed array in same panel

nodes.label: Normalised photocurrent switching at 365, 625, 850 nm looks the same at 0, 50 and 100% stretch
Normalised photocurrent switching looks the same at the 1st, 50th and 100th stretch cycle
ON/OFF flat from 0 to 100% stretch: ~50 (625), ~30 (365), ~4 (850 nm) within error bars
Rise (~0.3-0.7 s) and fall (~0.4-0.55 s) times flat from 0 to 100% stretch
625 nm ON/OFF of the nominally same 60 wt%/4.4 nm NWPD reads ~600 (F2), ~200 (F3a) and ~50 (F4e)

attrs.image_note: light intensities differ (F2 0.67, F4 0.78 mW/cm2 at 625 nm) but F4 is higher, so intensity does not explain the ~12x drop; F4 is PDMS-embedded array
requires_unseen: F2 and F4 devices are 60 wt% / 4.4 nm QD (linked text)
F3a loading series uses 4.4 nm QDs (linked text)

nodes.label: P3HT-only (0 wt%) device gives ON/OFF ~3 at 740 nm and ~3.7 at 680 nm while 0 wt% film absorbance is ~0 beyond ~660 nm

attrs.image_note: cross-panel check: F3a 0 wt% points against F3c 0 wt% absorbance curve (main panel ~0 above ~660 nm; inset 0 wt% trace ~0.01-0.02 at 800-1300 nm, film on quartz not NW)

notes: Two spine branches after forming: QD dispersion -> charge transfer -> NIR photoresponse -> single-NWPD performance, and arch shape -> strain relaxation -> stretch-stable array. Loading and size trends kept as side claims. Photoresponse, PL and EDS plots (F2, F3a/b/d, F4c-f, F1b inset) carry a false OCR 'micrograph' cue; the judge restored their panel citations and logged each under review.cue_overrides. Supplementary Figs S1-S11 and Table 1 not in packet. Audits: o20 cross-figure ON/OFF magnitude mismatch for the same device type; o21 P3HT-only device responds at 680-740 nm where its film absorbance is ~0.
